messages:
maria: Quick bug from onboarding: sample app shows `Request failed (500)` with no next steps. Customers confused.

aj: Can we get the raw response? If runtime drops an `error_code` we lose signal.

maria: Snippet from network tab (sanitized): `{ "status":500, "error":"InternalServerError", "message":"handler panic" }`

sam: Proposal: runtime responses should include `error_code` (string), `message` (dev-facing), optional `retry_after` (seconds). SDKs map to typed exceptions exposing `code`, `retryable`, `retryAfter`, `traceId`, and `raw`.

zoe: For sample apps, show two flows: dev panel with raw telemetry (message+traceId) and a user banner using a mapped friendly string (never raw message). Provide a tiny lookup example in README.

aj: Gateway must not convert model-level codes to generic 500. Preserve `error_code` and add middleware to normalize older patterns. Also add e2e that injects `model_oom`.

ci-bot: infra-bot created PR 4472 to add `error_code` + `retry_after` + `trace_id` to runtime responses: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4472

sam: Example JS handler for sample app: `try { await client.generate() } catch (e) { if (e.code === 'auth_expired') showReauth(); else if (e.retryable) scheduleBackoff(e.retryAfter); logTelemetry(e.raw); }`

zoe: Action items: runtime -> land PR; SDKs -> add typed errors and `.raw` (Sam); sample app -> add mapping table + UI examples (Zoe); docs -> publish canonical error code list (Aj).

maria: Aim for next sprint. I'll draft the onboarding copy snippets once PR is on staging. :rocket:
